Token metadata effect cache
===========================

`getTokenMetadata` is an effect, so its results are cached in this directory.
Without a warm cache the indexer refetches every token's name, symbol and
decimals over RPC — 15.1 million rows' worth across 18 chains at the last
count. That is the single biggest avoidable cost of a fresh sync.

The cache is too large for git, so it is hosted on Google Drive:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PNodRythHPOwbIEr9k5jPwx4gg1TTwKH?usp=sharing

Cache data last updated: 22/07/2026 (inherited from uniswap-v4-indexer)

LAYOUT: one directory per chain
-------------------------------

This indexer sets `disable_default_cross_chain: true`, which makes effect
caches per-chain:

  .envio/cache/
    1/getTokenMetadata.tsv
    10/getTokenMetadata.tsv
    8453/getTokenMetadata.tsv
    ...one directory per chain id

A single flat `.envio/cache/getTokenMetadata.tsv` is read as a *cross-chain*
cache, which this indexer no longer uses. It does not error — it is silently
ignored and every token is refetched over RPC. upstream's flat file was
deleted from this repository for exactly that reason, so if you see one
reappear, it is doing nothing.

To warm your local cache:
1. Download getTokenMetadata-per-chain-<date>.zip from the Drive folder.
2. Unzip into `.envio/cache/` so the chain-id directories sit directly inside.
3. Make sure no flat `getTokenMetadata.tsv` is left beside them.

The cache keys are `["0xADDRESS",CHAIN_ID]` in both layouts, so the per-chain
files are a pure repartition of the old flat file: 15,145,083 rows in,
15,145,083 rows out.

Deploying to Envio Cloud
------------------------

The cloud build uses whatever is committed here. Since the per-chain cache is
not in git, a cloud deploy starts cold and refetches metadata over RPC, which
makes the `ENVIO_*_RPC_URL` settings in DEPLOY.md matter. Envio Cloud's own
cache save/restore is the other half of this; see DEPLOY.md.
